### Define validation metrics
```{python}
def compute_mse(ground_truths, predicted_values):

    mse = 0
    n_data = len(ground_truths)
    for i in range(n_data):
        y_truth = ground_truths[i]
        y_predicted = predicted_values[i]
        mse += ((y_truth - y_predicted)**2)/n_data

    return mse

def compute_rmse(ground_truths, predicted_values):
    mse = compute_mse(ground_truths, predicted_values)

    return np.sqrt(mse)


def compute_mae(ground_truths, predicted_values):
    mae = 0
    n_data = len(ground_truths)
    for i in range(n_data):
        y_truth = ground_truths[i]
        y_predicted = predicted_values[i]
        mae += np.abs(y_truth - y_predicted)/n_data

    return mae


def compute_improvement(ground_truths, predicted_values, training_data):
    n_data = len(ground_truths)
    mean_val = sum(training_data[i] for i in range(len(training_data))) / len(training_data)
    rmse_dummy = compute_rmse(ground_truths, [mean_val] * n_data)
    rmse_model = compute_rmse(ground_truths, predicted_values)
    return 1.0 - rmse_model / rmse_dummy
```

### Monterrey dictionaries
One dictionary per row.
```{python}
monterrey_dictionaries = []
def get_all_characteristics(training_instances, validation_instances, model, model_family, city_name, combined = False):
    result_dictionary = {}
    result_dictionary["Model Family"] = model_family
    result_dictionary["N"] = len(validation_instances)
    result_dictionary["Validation City"] = city_name
    if(not combined):
        result_dictionary["Training"] = "City"
    else:
        result_dictionary["Training"] = "Combined"
    

    features = [x["features"] for x in validation_instances]
    if(model_family == "Footprint XGBoost"):
        #The footprint model only uses the 13 footprint features, which come first.
        features = [x["features"][:13] for x in validation_instances]
    heights_validation = [x["real_height"] for x in validation_instances]
    heights_training = [x["real_height"] for x in training_instances]
    predictions = model.predict(np.array(features))

    rmse = compute_rmse(
        heights_validation,
        predictions
    )

    mae = compute_mae(
        heights_validation,
        predictions
    )

    improvement = compute_improvement(
        heights_validation,
        predictions,
        heights_training
    )

    result_dictionary["RMSE"] = rmse
    result_dictionary["MAE"] = mae
    result_dictionary["Improvement (%)"] = improvement*100

    return result_dictionary

monterrey_dictionaries.append(get_all_characteristics(training_data_monterrey, validation_data_monterrey, ctp_model_monterrey, "CTP", "Monterrey"))
monterrey_dictionaries.append(get_all_characteristics(training_data_monterrey, validation_data_monterrey, single_model_monterrey, "Single XGBoost", "Monterrey"))
monterrey_dictionaries.append(get_all_characteristics(training_data_monterrey, validation_data_monterrey, footprint_model_monterrey, "Footprint XGBoost", "Monterrey"))
monterrey_dictionaries.append(get_all_characteristics(training_data_pooled, validation_data_monterrey, ctp_model_pooled, "CTP", "Monterrey", combined = True))
monterrey_dictionaries.append(get_all_characteristics(training_data_pooled, validation_data_monterrey, single_model_pooled, "Single XGBoost", "Monterrey", combined = True))
monterrey_dictionaries.append(get_all_characteristics(training_data_pooled, validation_data_monterrey, footprint_model_pooled, "Footprint XGBoost", "Monterrey", combined = True))
```

### Differences against the CTP
(only $RMSE$, computed before rounding)
```{python}
rmse_ctp = {(x["Validation City"], x["Training"]): x["RMSE"] for x in all_dictionaries if x["Model Family"] == "CTP"}
other_dictionaries = [x for x in all_dictionaries if x["Model Family"] != "CTP"]

differences_dictionary = {
    "Validation city": [x["Validation City"] for x in other_dictionaries],
    "Training": [x["Training"] for x in other_dictionaries],
    "Model family": [x["Model Family"] for x in other_dictionaries],
    "RMSE - RMSE CTP": [round(x["RMSE"] - rmse_ctp[(x["Validation City"], x["Training"])], 3) for x in other_dictionaries]
}

differences = pd.DataFrame(data = differences_dictionary).pivot(
    index = "Model family",
    columns = ["Validation city", "Training"],
    values = "RMSE - RMSE CTP"
)
differences
```

### Differences between city and combined training
(only $RMSE$, computed before rounding)
```{python}
rmse_combined = {(x["Validation City"], x["Model Family"]): x["RMSE"] for x in all_dictionaries if x["Training"] == "Combined"}
city_dictionaries = [x for x in all_dictionaries if x["Training"] == "City"]

training_differences_dictionary = {
    "Validation city": [x["Validation City"] for x in city_dictionaries],
    "Model family": [x["Model Family"] for x in city_dictionaries],
    "RMSE city - RMSE combined": [round(x["RMSE"] - rmse_combined[(x["Validation City"], x["Model Family"])], 3) for x in city_dictionaries]
}

training_differences = pd.DataFrame(data = training_differences_dictionary).pivot(
    index = "Model family",
    columns = "Validation city",
    values = "RMSE city - RMSE combined"
)
training_differences = training_differences[["Monterrey", "Boston", "San Francisco"]]
training_differences
```
